method: Chrome Settings > Appearance > Page zoom native select in isolated disposable headed Chrome profile. Verified via chrome.settingsPrivate.getDefaultZoom. No emulated viewport, CSS zoom, deviceScaleFactor, or pageScaleFactor.
screenshotMethod: CDP Page.captureScreenshot without clip; captureBeyondViewport false, fromSurface true. Visible viewport screenshots preserve actual zoom; Playwright fullPage was not used for final artifacts.
checks: Actual Chrome page zoom 200% independently read as 2, DPR ratio 2, halved CSS viewport, unchanged native window, CSS zoom 1, visualViewport scale 1.

Labels visible, status selection and clear filters work by keyboard at 200%; edit is reachable through the local table scroll region; dialog fields editable and cancel keyboard-reachable, no horizontal overflow.

os.baseDisplayScale: Native Windows display DPR 1.25 measured at Chrome page zoom 100%; this is OS scaling, distinct from browser page zoom 200%.
